Jordan / Laura — reviewed the docs. Guidance below (keeps our audit trail straightforward):

1) Vendor tax status: CUIT provided and invoice sample look good for IVA registration. No further Argentinian tax cert required for a standard supplier relationship.

2) PO approach (recommended): Use a split-PO template for suppliers that charge IVA where Redwood needs to capture withholding/withheld tax for local reporting. This should create two lines:
   - Line 1: Net service/goods amount (GL mapped to supplier expense)
   - Line 2: IVA / tax withholding amount (GL mapped to AR withholding ledger)

3) Invoice requirements: insist vendor includes: CUIT, PO number, line item references, CAE code (if applicable), and explicit IVA line with rate. For reconciliation we will also request the invoice file name to include invoice number + CUIT.

4) Vendor profile actions: Jordan, please set vendor tax classification to "ARG - Registered IVA" and upload the CUIT PDF to the vendor record. Laura, please enable the PO split flag for this vendor and route tax withholding lines to tax code AR-IVA-01.

5) Timeline: If vendor confirms they can reference the PO lines on their invoice, we can issue the PO tomorrow and target payment on Net30 after invoice receipt.
